## Change and reason

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior and any related issue.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. For native write changes, include
the STEP 7 version and import → compile → export result. For documentation-only
changes, state which links and language counterparts were checked.

## Documentation and dependencies

Mention EN/RU documentation updates, screenshots for interface changes, and
license/provenance notes for any dependency changes. Write "Not applicable"
where appropriate.
